dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (日医標準レセプトソフト); compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING, LINKAGE SECTION with USING, and typical ORCA coding conventions.

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (レセプト) system — inpatient accounting sub-program (入院会計作成サブ)
purpose.summary: This subprogram (ORCSNYUACCT) is part of the JMA ORCA medical receipt software system. It creates/updates inpatient accounting records (入院会計), calculating hospitalization fees, meal charges, selected medical fees, and handling date-range logic for inpatient stays. It is called with a linkage area containing patient and treatment parameters and performs multiple CALLs to other ORCA subsystem modules.

notable_features: 36 CALL statements to other ORCA subsystem modules
300 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
LINKAGE SECTION with SPA-AREA and ORCSNYUACCT-AREA
Japanese EUC/Shift-JIS encoded comments (decoded as latin-1)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 fields despite financial calculations
OCCURS tables for inpatient treatment data
Date arithmetic for hospitalization period calculations
verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), appearing as mojibake. This is a well-known open-source Japanese medical system (JMA ORCA). The program is a large (4352 lines) production subprogram. Source truncated at 16000 chars; full analysis based on visible structure and mechanical indicators.
